item.text: I’ve got the file. I’m checking line numbers now so I can point to the exact defects instead of describing them loosely.

`test/orders.js` is a small order-utility module. It exports four helpers:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price * qty` across items.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies a 10% or 20% discount for known codes.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: computes an average from the total and item count.
- `formatOrder(order)`: renders item lines plus a final discounted total.

Bugs I see:

- [Line 5] `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length` instead of `< items.length`, so it runs one step too far and reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`. That will throw when it tries to access `.price` and `.qty`.
- [Line 20] `averageItemPrice` divides by `items.length` without guarding against an empty array, so `[]` produces `NaN` or `Infinity` depending on how the earlier bug is hit.
- [Line 18-20] The function name is also a bit misleading: it averages the extended order total, not the average unit price. If items can have different quantities, this gives a weighted result rather than the simple mean of item prices.
- [Line 25-26] `formatOrder` depends on `calcTotal`, so it will also fail until the loop bug is fixed.

If you want, I can also rewrite the file with the fixes.
